recap.analyst:
Lombardia Nord and Navigli United drew 1-1. On expected goals it finished 0.64–0.13: Lombardia Nord did enough to win on chances and will feel they dropped points.

Navigli United had 51% of the ball. Pass completion LOM 74% (111/149), NAV 81% (151/187). Shots 6–1, on target 1–1.

Lombardia Nord started in a 4-3-3 (low block), Navigli United in a 4-3-3 (balanced). Neither coach changed shape.

Turning point, 21': D. Navvena was sent off (a second yellow). Lombardia Nord played the rest with ten, which usually costs a side about a third of its attacking output.

By the numbers: S. Fujisawa completed the most passes (30); J. Namlagu hit the top speed (31.8 km/h); G. Inooka covered the most ground (6.06 km, a 17.2 km per-90 pace); T. Djedele won the most challenges (17).

Discipline: fouls 6–5, yellows 2–1, reds 1–0, offsides 0–0. Conditions: overcast, 21°C, pitch dry, firm.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Arena Lombarda, Milan. L. Serchard broke the deadlock in the 32nd minute. G. Inooka struck in the 65th for Lombardia Nord. And the red card changed everything. Navigli United had more of the ball, but neither side could find a winner. The hero: L. Serchard, with the goal that mattered. Honours even. Both sets of fans go home with something.
